model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and the corresponding ACC (%) values for different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines in the plot. The first, colored black with circular markers, represents “Base”, starting at approximately (1, 41) and ending at approximately (1000, 44). The second, colored brown with diamond markers, represents “MEND”, beginning at about (1, 57) and ending near (1000, 58). The third, blue with triangular markers, represents “FT”, starting at (1, 44) and finishing at roughly (1000, 48). The fourth, red with a downward triangle marker, represents “IKE”, beginning at around (1, 44) and ending near (1000, 52). Lastly, the fifth line, colored green with square markers, represents “ROME,” starting at approximately (1, 50) and ending at approximately (1000, 62).
